platform.environment_note: Apple Silicon CPU, no GPU/MPS/CUDA; deterministic dense numpy/scipy linear algebra

config.name: Born analytic/literature control
config.pose_theta_convention: theta = atan2(-p_y, -p_x): body +x axis points toward the origin

scene_family.rule: chi_s = s * chi0, chi0 = family1.make_chi0(points, cfg) (two_blob)

fixed_named_low_contrast.name: standard low_contrast scene = 0.1 * two_blob (also in scale grid)

whitening.note: identity noise: hh.whiten_realify(A_c, B_c, None) = sqrt(2)*[Re(A_c); Im(A_c)] and same for B_c; real data rows 48

born.module_path: hh.born_forward(chi, poses, rx_offsets, tx_offset, N, k_b)
born.return: (F_born, A_born); per-pose block A_born,t = G_S_t diag(E_inc_t)
born.formula_note: self-derived Born forward map A_born,t = G_S_t diag(E_inc_t), F_born,t = G_S_t (chi_s * E_inc_t); equivalently the linear full-wave Jacobian at chi = 0 (verified to roundoff by family 3b check D)
born.composition_identity_note: explicit composition path recomputes G_S_stack diag(E_inc) from hh.build_operators lists, whiten_realifies it with the same B_c, projects with S, and compares with the hh.born_forward path

retention.no_prior_rule: P_perp = I - Z Z^T, Z = family2.range_basis(B_R)
retention.same_B_R_note: B_R is the FULL-WAVE pose Jacobian at chi_s (identity-noise realified) and is used for both full-wave and Born rows because the Born data map has no pose sensitivity of its own in the linearized model; this is a documented analytic-control choice
retention.spectrum_rule: rho = family4.retention_spectrum(A_s, W) = eig(Q_A^T W Q_A), thin-SVD normalised retention of K = A_s^T W A_s w.r.t. K_IS = A_s^T A_s

finite_prior.W_rule: W = I - B_R (B_R^T B_R + alpha I)^{-1} B_R^T (family4.shrinkage_operator)
finite_prior.K_eff_rule: K_eff = A_s^T W A_s (family4.K_eff(A_s, B_R, alpha))

convergence.fit_rule: slope of log10(relative Frobenius error) vs log10(s) across the full six-scale grid; reported as observed, not forced
convergence.expected_rule: slope ~1 expected if the relative Born error is dominated by the O(s) first correction

confounded_directions.source: family4.generalized_eigen_directions(A_s, P_perp): ascending generalized eigenvalues of A_s^T P_perp A_s in the K_IS metric; first three directions are the most pose-confounded
confounded_directions.comparison_rule: normalized squared overlaps |u^T v|^2/(||u||^2 ||v||^2) and principal angles (deg) of QR-orthonormalised 3-dim subspaces

config.randomness_note: deterministic dense linear algebra; no RNG used
config.scope_note: Finite-dimensional N=16 toy only (m=48 real data rows, p=24 smooth coefficients, q_pose=18). Internal analytic control; no continuum limit, no external quantitative benchmark, no independent validation claim.
config.literature_rule: single verbatim citation supplied by the parent task

scope_note: Finite-dimensional N=16 toy only (m=48 real data rows, p=24 smooth coefficients, q_pose=18). Internal analytic control; no continuum limit, no external quantitative benchmark, no independent validation claim.

literature.citation: M. L. Diong, A. Roueff, P. Lasaygues, A. Litman, "Impact of the Born approximation on the estimation error in 2D inverse scattering", Inverse Problems, 2016.
literature.reference_statement: The paper quantifies the Born approximation's effect on estimation error by comparing the linear Born MLE variance with the full nonlinear Cramer-Rao bound (CRB).
literature.our_control_mapping: Family 15 is a formula-level/internal analytic control with the same conceptual structure: the Born FIM K_IS_born = A_born^T A_born is the inverse covariance of the linear Born Gaussian estimator, and the full-wave K_IS/K_eff is the local FIM of the nonlinear full-wave map.
literature.no_external_benchmark: No quantitative external benchmark was possible because the published setup's geometry, normalization, noise model, parameterization, and units were not reproduced here; this is not independent validation.
literature.claim_rule: No numerical value from the cited paper is claimed to match family 15.

born_identity_summary.rule: self-derived Born forward map A_born,t = G_S_t diag(E_inc_t), F_born,t = G_S_t (chi_s * E_inc_t); equivalently the linear full-wave Jacobian at chi = 0 (verified to roundoff by family 3b check D)
